function selectSpot(i){const cards=[...document.querySelectorAll('.card')],pins=[...document.querySelectorAll('.pin')];cards.forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));pins.forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));const c=cards[i];if(!c)return;c.classList.add('active');if(pins[i])pins[i].classList.add('active');selname.textContent='SELECTED  '+String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')+' — '+c.dataset.name;selprice.textContent='€'+c.dataset.price}
document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach((c,i)=>c.onclick=()=>selectSpot(i));document.querySelectorAll('.pin').forEach(p=>p.onclick=()=>selectSpot(+p.dataset.spot));selectSpot(0);
